verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. A splits the headline more naturally as 'Chase / the Light', while B's 'Chase the / Light' leaves 'Light' alone on the second line. Both share the same flaws: the SOLSTICE wordmark is shrunk to an illegible size and the sun icon loses its rays. The CTA is blown up so it runs nearly edge to edge and competes with the headline. The headline, CTA and logo are packed tightly together with almost no breathing room, so the airy, spacious feel of the original is gone.
